coverageNote: Bounded review of nine supplied primary sources; not a claim of exhaustive literature coverage.
lowerBoundStatus: Elapsed-round lower bounds are shown under their deterministic or randomized contracts. Sleeping points display elapsed-time upper bounds; no separate sleeping-specific lower claim is added.
axisSemantics: One elapsed-round axis, with ordinal growth families rather than numerical distances. L² and Õ(L²) share a clearly labeled soft-growth family; exact factors stay on the points and in theorem inspection. Degree-dependent expressions use conservative enclosures under 1≤Δ<n, not achieved-time ranges.
